label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (ssrf): alert-TP. User input flows directly to connectHttpByHostname(host) which opens an HTTP connection. The isNonPublicAddress check only validates resolved IP types (loopback/site-local/link-local/any-local) but misses critical bypasses: DNS rebinding, IPv6-mapped addresses, and external hosts that pass the check. Resolved sink value at line 44 is the user-supplied host parameter, allowing SSRF to internal/private resources.

evidence.note: User param flows to host, DNS resolved, then connectHttpByHostname(host) executes HTTP request to potentially malicious target
